notes.title: Contest!
notes.content:
In addition, we have announced the start of a competition to draw the most terrible, incredible evil spirits. If you want to participate, arm yourself with pencils, remember Russian folk superstitions and give free rein to your imagination!

You will be required to:
1. To invent and draw (mould/sew/cut out of wood) a wicked thing. We accept works in any technique you like without restrictions

2. Add to the drawing a description of the uncleanness (name, place of habitation, main features of appearance and character)

3. Send the drawing and text to us by e-mail pr@babayagagames.ru or in messages in our group VK with the mark ‘contest’ until 9 September.

4. Wait for the results of the contest on 16 September

To take part in the contest, do not forget to fulfil these conditions

🎮 Play the Prologue of the game (so it will be easier for you to think up your own variant of evil and not to repeat the existing one in the game). If you leave a review on our Steam page, we'd appreciate it!
👹 Your evil for the contest should be in the spirit of Slavic mythology. Even if you decide to make up your own evil, references to folk folklore are required.
🤖 Draw the evil one yourself without the help of neural networks. Even if you think you don't have much experience, try it anyway. Trust me, it's much more important and interesting than what artificial intelligence can produce.
How will we determine the winner?
There will be two winners! One will be chosen by us, the other by our subscribers.

After 9 September, we will hold a vote on the wall of the groups in VK and Telegram.

What is the prize?
Your character will get into Vasilisa and Baba Yaga: The Beginning and become one of the enemies that the Magic Doll can fight!

notes.title: The download button has appeared!
notes.content: We've been waiting for a long time and now, finally, Steam has given us a download button on the prologue page! Now you can definitely play!

notes.title: Problem with prologue release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116152/2d0681b8525baf22496648b0edfdf39ecef28be6.jpg[/img]
Guys, we were supposed to have a prologue release today and we already prepared a post about it for you, but after we published the prologue, it turned out that Steam has some kind of bug and there is no download button on the store page. We know that you receive notifications that the game is available, but, unfortunately, this is not the case. We are very sorry, we wrote to support a long time ago, but still have not received an answer. We will definitely let you know when everything gets better and the game becomes truly available!
